label: end-of-episode / low-value unit (last ~10 trials), suppressed by a1 input
explanation: Fires almost only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode: 97% of activation mass is at ep_trial 90-99 (rate 0.50 there, 0.03 at 80-89, zero before 80), across all three phases. The model value head drops near the end of the episode and tracks this; value < 5.22 (bottom decile) covers 99.5% of mass. ep_trial >= 90 alone gives dev F1 0.65 (mass recall 0.97); value < 4.5 gives F1 0.75. Within the late window it is suppressed when the a1 action input is on (D2 after choosing a1: rate 0.007) and weaker on S1 states; it is stronger for a2 choices / S2 good, after reward (in_rew=1 rate 0.08 vs 0.04), and after D1 fixation errors. Recorded (value < 4.5) & ~(in_action == 1), dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.94; value is the model own output, so no future variables. Magnitude grows as the episode end approaches (activations ramp over consecutive trials within late windows) and is largest at D1/GO after reward with a2 history. Does not fire at all before trial ~80. Precision limited (~0.7) because many late a1-history steps are inactive.
